observations: Seller says they tested it and repeats claims, but no new photos/videos were provided.
Photos remain the same: an IBC tank in a steel cage; no clearly readable capacity/certification/food-grade markings are visible in the provided images.
No visible evidence in the photos confirms leak-free status or lid completeness.

claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: Photos do not show UN/DOT/chemical-compatibility certification or markings; seller’s test claim is not supported by new evidence.
No clearly readable food-grade/NSF/FDA/food-contact certification markings are visible in the photos; seller provides no new proof.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Photos cannot confirm prior contents; no new photos/labels showing history.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete
claims.evidence: No leak test video/clip or close-ups of lids/closures are provided; photos do not clearly confirm leak-free condition.

claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true
claims.evidence: Statement only; no new test evidence (video/clip) was shared.

risks.risk: Food-grade certification may be false or not documented; tank may have held non-food chemicals or may not be certified for food contact.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the IBC data plate/label showing food-contact/NSF or equivalent certification and any prior-use/compatibility info; also photo of bung/lid markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a general-purpose used IBC (not food-grade).

risks.risk: Leak-free status is not proven remotely; micro-leaks can occur at valve/gasket/seams and won’t be confirmed by the current photos.
risks.proof: Video/clip of a fill-and-hold leak test (show valve area, bottom outlet, seams) or a pressure test with no drips for a short hold period.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially not guaranteed leak-free (worst case for buyer).

risks.risk: Capacity/size unknown; value depends on whether it’s standard 1000L or another size.
risks.proof: Photo of the capacity marking (e.g., 1000L) on the IBC data plate/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case assumption for value (standard used IBC without confirmed capacity).

risks.risk: Structural condition (cage welds, tank corners/bottom) may be worse than it looks; scuffs could hide dents or deformation.
risks.proof: Full 360° photos of tank corners, bottom, and cage weld points; close-ups of any dents/deformations.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with cosmetic wear and no structural guarantee.

proof_requests: Send a short video of a leak test: fill with water, show the valve/outlet area and seams, then hold for a few minutes with no drips.
Send clear photos of the IBC data plate/label showing capacity and any certification/food-grade markings.
Send close-ups of the top lid/closures and the bottom outlet valve assembly including gaskets/seals.
Send full 360° photos of the tank corners/bottom and cage weld points.
response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not supported by new evidence. Without proof (leak-test video and readable markings for capacity/food-grade), the correct worst-case pricing cannot be set confidently.
